about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The humans behind the flames
about.intro: We are Vicedomini Softworks — an Italian software company that builds things people actually use. We built this tool because the internet is full of terrible websites, and most of them will never know it.
about.mission: Our mission: brutal honesty delivered with AI precision. No fluff. No sugar-coating. Just the truth about your site, whether you want to hear it or not.
about.team: Based in Italy. Powered by curiosity, strong coffee, and a deep contempt for bad UX. We build web apps, sites, and custom software for clients who aren't afraid of the truth.
about.cta: Need something built right? Contact us →
about.statsSubtitle: and counting — the internet is still bad

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: The brutal truth, step by step
howItWorks.intro: Our AI doesn't sugarcoat. Here's exactly what happens when you submit a URL.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Paste any public website address. If it's your own site, brace yourself.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI fetches your site's content, checks robots.txt, sitemap, performance, agent compatibility, and everything it can find. It reads everything. It judges everything.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Each selected category gets a score from 1 to 10, a brutal critique, and a prompt you can give an AI agent to actually fix it.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Get your overall score, share the result, or quietly fix your site in the dark. We don't judge. (Actually, we do. That's the whole point.)
